Privacy policy

Last updated: 14 October 2026

Privacy policyDelete your account

This policy explains how TripWallet, published by Healiora Developers, handles information when you use the app. TripWallet helps groups organise trips, share expenses and record settlements.

Information we handle

  • Account information: email address, authentication information, account identifier, display name and an optional UPI payment address.
  • Shared trip information: trip names, invitation codes, membership, itinerary entries, expense descriptions and amounts, receipt-derived items, expense shares, balances, recorded settlements and activity.
  • Photos and camera: images you choose for receipt recognition and camera frames used to scan receipts or trip QR codes.
  • Technical information: services handling app requests may process IP addresses, request timestamps and security or delivery logs. Included Google ML Kit components may process device, application and SDK performance information under Google's policies.
  • Support information: messages and contact details you send when requesting help or account deletion.

Why we use this information

We use information to create and authenticate accounts, send verification and password-reset emails, provide shared trips, calculate expense splits and balances, synchronise records, process support requests and protect the service against abuse. TripWallet does not include advertising or sell personal data.

Sharing and service providers

Members of the same trip can see shared trip records, participant names and saved payment addresses. Only share information with people you intend to include in that trip. Exporting or sharing records sends them to the destinations you choose.

TripWallet uses Supabase for authentication and cloud data storage and Brevo for account emails. These providers process the information required to deliver their services. Google ML Kit is used for scanning features; see ML Kit terms and Google's privacy policy. Service processing may occur in countries other than your own.

Receipt images and permissions

Receipt text recognition runs on your device. TripWallet synchronises the expense information you review and save, rather than uploading the original receipt photo to its trip database. Camera access is used when you choose to scan a receipt or a trip QR code. Photo selection is used when you choose an existing receipt image. You can manage permissions in Android settings. TripWallet does not request contacts, SMS or precise location access.

External payments

If you choose to pay using a UPI app, TripWallet passes the payment address, recipient name, amount and payment note to the selected external payment app. That app handles the payment under its own terms and privacy policy. TripWallet does not hold funds, collect your UPI PIN or bank login, or independently verify payment success.

Storage and security

Account and shared trip information is stored with Supabase and cached on your device. App connections to Supabase use HTTPS. Access controls restrict shared records to authorised accounts. No storage or transmission method is guaranteed completely secure.

Signing out does not automatically erase locally cached records. Clearing app storage removes the local copy, including any unsynchronised changes. Keep your device secure.

Retention and deletion

Account data is retained while your account is active and needed to provide the service. You can delete your account in Profile → Delete my account or request deletion using our account-deletion page.

Account deletion removes your sign-in account and profile. Saved names, avatar links and UPI addresses on retained trip memberships are cleared or replaced with “Deleted account”. Shared financial records and participant identifiers remain to preserve other members' balances and history. Expense descriptions or other shared text are not automatically scrubbed of personal details; contact us about specific information you need removed. Trips owned by you with no other members are deleted; ownership of shared trips transfers to another member. The in-app deletion flow also clears the active account's local records on that device.

Support correspondence and provider security, delivery or backup records may remain as needed for support, security, service recovery or legal obligations, under the relevant provider's retention practices. Deleting your account does not erase copies previously exported by other trip members. Contact us for questions about retained information.

Your choices

You can update your profile and optional UPI ID, export expense records, manage device permissions and request correction or deletion through the contact address below. Do not email passwords, verification codes, UPI PINs or bank credentials.

This website

This policy website contains no app login form, advertising or custom analytics scripts. Its hosting provider may process network and request information needed to deliver and secure the page.
